User-defined regulatory network

Source: R/model.R
grn_custom.Rd

For regulatory relations that the Hill model in [grn()] cannot express. Development and derivatives run in R, so this is slower than [grn()].

Usage

grn_custom(
  rhs,
  params,
  genes,
  evolvable = names(params),
  traits = NULL,
  jacobian = NULL,
  x0 = 1
)

Arguments

rhs

Function `rhs(x, p)` returning \(dx/dt\) for expression vector `x` and named parameter vector `p`.

params

Named numeric vector of all parameters (defaults).

genes

Gene names, or number of genes.

evolvable

Names of parameters in `params` that are loci.

traits

Genes under selection (names or indices).

jacobian

Optional function `jacobian(x, p)` returning the \(n \times n\) matrix \(\partial f/\partial x\). Numerical if omitted.

x0

Default initial expression state.

Value

An object of class `custom_grn`.

Examples

# additive (OR-logic) activation of x2 by x1, which grn() cannot express
m <- grn_custom(
  function(x, p) c(p["a1"] - x[1],
                   p["a2"] * (0.2 + x[1] / (5 + x[1])) - x[2]),
  params = c(a1 = 2, a2 = 2), genes = c("x1", "x2"))
